name: anxiety_screening
remarks: Replaces src/main/resources/modules/encounter/anxiety_screening.json with a module that does nothing. Load it with -d config/common/modules.

The original runs a GAD-7 screening at wellness encounters with a United States prevalence (23.4% of women, 12.6% of men by its own transitions) and writes the finding Severe anxiety (panic) (33% of patients). The rates are not local and nothing else reads its score or finding.
